- SLA: 99th percentile per-token latency guarantee for routed requests (applies to the H100 units) and a throughput guarantee of 40 reqs/s sustained for the clinical models during business hours.
- Term: 12 months with an optional auto-renew and a mid-term migration support window.

I've attached a short PPD analysis and a draft amendment for internal review. If this looks sensible, Ben can pull together an updated term sheet and I can route a DocuSign when you confirm the numbers.

Answers inline and a few clarifications: 

1) Run-rate: see tab "Commit vs Current" in the attached workbook. Roughly, add ~27% to your current monthly committed spend for the initial quarter when H100 is priced at premium; effective performance-per-dollar for your production models improves ~1.6x at targeted sequence lengths (tracked in the PPD sheet). I pulled the sample numbers into the top-level summary so procurement can paste into their capex/opex table.

2) SLA credit: yes, we can make the 99th percentile latency SLA dollar-backed. Draft language: failure events measured monthly; credit equal to 5% of monthly dedicated invoice for each 4-hour contiguous breach, capped at 50% of monthly invoice. We can tighten the measurement window if you prefer.

3) KV cache migration: zero-RPO caching strategy possible via prefix warm-up + staged routing. There is a short catch-over period (~5–10 minutes) during which requests route to H100 cold cache; we recommend a 2-hour maintenance window for the initial rollout to fully prime caches and validate.

Quick runbook (high-level) for the HW uplift and pool addition: 

- Pre-cutover (48–72 hrs): sync key prompts and eval prompts to the staging pool; validate perf on L40S-backed quantized variant for non-critical workloads.
- Cutover window (2 hours): split traffic 10/90 -> 50/50 -> 100% to H100 pool with live latency monitoring; warm the KV cache with synthetic prefixes then replay small production batch. Expect a ~5–10 minute cold-cache tail before warm-up completes.
- Rollback: re-route traffic to the original A100 pool (identical model versions pinned) and drain the new pool; logs and traces retained for 30 days to support rollback analysis.

I'll attach a one-page runbook to the amendment before we send it for signature. Also, we'll set up a follow-up joint test 48 hours post-cutover.
